alpha.description: 显著性阈值;用于 auto 的正态/方差判断与 significant/stars 列的划线

feature_col.description: 长表中作为 feature 的列名(全局兜底);TE 轴下由 node.py 按 contrast 自动覆盖(feature_col_by_contrast),此处留 null 即可

te_levels.description: TE 轴检验层级: node.py 把每个组对×每层级展开成带后缀 contrast(youth_vs_aged.subfamily 等),结果并存;只要一个层级就删掉另一个

ylabel.description: 柱状图 y 轴标签;null 显示 value(建议填有意义的标签如 CpG per fiber)

enabled.description: Gate the sv_mei analysis (MEI classification + figure suite).

min_len.description: Minimum inserted-sequence length (bp) sent to RepeatMasker; shorter events stay 'short_unclassified'.

full_length.description: Minimum insertion length (bp) for full-length candidacy.

full_length_family.description: Bucket name considered for full-length candidacy (L1 by default; e.g. an ERVK bucket for other clades).

name.description: Bucket display name; never used for matching.

subfamily.description: Exact (case-insensitive) match against the RM repeat NAME (AluY / B1_Mm / IAP1 ...).

family.description: Exact match against the RM class/family suffix (SINE/Alu -> Alu; no-slash entries match whole string).

class.description: Exact match against the RM class/family prefix (SINE, LTR, DNA ...). Only the FIRST non-empty of subfamily/family/class participates (probe order subfamily -> family -> class).

catch_all.description: classified: RM hit but no bucket matched; unclassified: no RM hit at all.

retro_fingerprint.description: true -> this bucket gets TSD detection (needs reference flanks) and is included in the retrotransposon fingerprint figure (polyA/TSD rates). Mark only active retrotransposon families (primate Alu/L1/SVA; mouse IAP/ETn, B1, B2/ID, L1).

zero_slot.description: false -> omit this bucket from figures when it has zero events (default true keeps the slot labelled 0).

te_buckets.description: Per-species ordered TE bucket lists keyed by genome reference key (like genome.references; different species get different default vocabularies). A plain bucket list is also accepted and applies as-is. node.py resolves the active genome's list into raw.json. Bucket dict keys: name, subfamily, family, class, catch_all, retro_fingerprint, zero_slot; matching schema in modules/sv/bin/mei_analysis.py.

chrom_prefix.description: Only sample windows on chroms starting with this prefix (NC_ for NCBI accessions; empty string = all chroms).

enabled.description: Opt-in gate for the fibercluster module (single-fiber pattern clustering + report package over this workflow's ft-extract element BEDs). node.py registers the outputs only when true; default false = wired but not invoked.

regions_bed.description: Regions BED (chrom<TAB>start<TAB>end<TAB>name rows; name = region label), required when enabled. Region names drive the per-region outputs.

settings.description: Setting labels = the module's {setting} wildcard values (one engine run each, the sigtest contrasts shape); every label needs a fiber_cluster.channel_by_setting and k_by_setting entry.

nuc_suffix.description: nuc element BED suffix; null disables the nucleosome overlay (-u)

fire_suffix.description: FIRE peaks BED suffix; null disables the FIRE overlay/channel (-f)

min_msp_bp.description: min MSP bp overlap for bin_mode=any (-P)

channel_by_setting.description: per-setting clustering channel msp|fire (feature_col_by_contrast shape); EVERY settings label must have an entry (-C)

k_by_setting.description: per-setting cluster count (feature_col_by_contrast shape); EVERY settings label must have an entry (-k)

min_span_frac.description: fiber must span this fraction of the region (-s)

right_tracks.description: right coverage-track layers, comma list or none (-T)

fire_fdr.description: keep FIRE peaks with FDR <= this (-q)

cache_dir.description: extraction cache dir (-y); empty = no cache (tabix jump still applies)

canonical.description: settings label whose figures/summary become the deliverable (-c); must be one of the settings labels
